svg.text: W14 · Public API v1, first endpoints: contract sketch · AWK-25 · 2026-10-15 · part 2 of 2
These endpoints become public (public-api.md, initial scope): surveys list and read, start an export, poll it, download it. Everything else stays App API.
Authorization: Bearer awk_7Hq2xR…9fPq // API key, Settings → API
Accept-Language: de | en // problem titles and details
401 unauthorized no key, unknown, expired or revoked key
403 scope-missing the key lacks the endpoint's scope
// 600 calls per minute per key; 3 exports running per organisation
// cookie sessions are refused here; API keys are refused on /api/app
Exports, downloads and every change made with a key are audited with the key as actor; other reads update its last use.
One type URI per error, listed in docs/api/errors.md; titles in German and English.
Newest change first, on a cursor (no offsets in the Public API).
404 survey-not-found // also for another organisation's survey
The definition itself (Askwerk JSON) follows with survey import/export, not here.
Idempotency-Key: 2c7e… // same key within 24 h → same export
Same exporters and codebook as the GUI (docs/api/exports.md).
Poll every few seconds, or wait for the export.completed webhook once webhooks exist.
New entities (data model; entity diagram updated in docs/architecture/data-model.svg with the build)
format, options (json: layout, values, language, filter)
// RLS per organisation; the job's payload is the export id
// looked up by prefix, compared in constant time
// last_used_at written at most once a minute

Public in this item: the five endpoints above, the API key authentication, rate limits, problem details, the OpenAPI snapshot (docs/api/openapi.json), docs/api/ (authentication, errors, exports) and a CHANGELOG entry.
Not in this item: OAuth client credentials, webhooks (export.completed), the MCP server, workspaces on keys, write scopes beyond what the presets name. Each is its own item.
SDKs: public-api.md asks for generated TypeScript, C# and Python SDKs with every public change. Generating them needs a generator, i.e. a new dependency.
Open for Dražan: (d) these five endpoints become public (recommended); (e) SDKs in a follow-up item with the generator choice and its warning (recommended), or here;
(f) the problem type URIs under https://askwerk.org/problems/… (recommended; a URI is only a name, it need not resolve) or under the instance's own address.
